title: On-bead purification and nanodisc reconstitution of human chemokine receptor complexes for structural and biophysical studies
protocol: Resuspend and thaw cell pellets with cold 40 mL Low Salt buffer on ice.
Dissolve 1 tablet of protease inhibitor in 1 mL Low Salt buffer.
Dissolve 100 mg iodoacetamide in 1 mL Low Salt buffer.
Add the dissolved reagents to the cell solution.
Homogenize the cell solution with a 40 mL glass dounce homogenizer 20–40 times.
Transfer the homogenized solution to a 50 mL conical tube.
Rotate the tube at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Add 40 mL cold 2× solubilization buffer containing 2 mM ATP to the cell lysate.
Stir the solubilization mixture in a glass beaker with a stir bar at 4°C for 3 h.
Centrifuge the solubilization mixture at 50,000–100,000 × g, 4°C for 30 min.
Keep the supernatant on ice for subsequent purification and reconstitution steps.
Wash Rho 1D4 antibody resin with Regular buffer.
Centrifuge washed resin at 300 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant after centrifugation.
Add solubilized receptor to the washed 1D4 resin; rotate mixture at 4°C for 2 hours.
Centrifuge receptor-1D4-resin mixture at 300 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant and wash resin with Regular buffer.
Centrifuge after washing and discard the supernatant again.
Transfer receptor-1D4-resin to two Protein lo-bind tubes; wash once more with Regular buffer.
Centrifuge as before and discard supernatant in each tube.
Dilute POPC:POPG lipid stock to 2 mM with Regular buffer.
Add 500 μL of diluted lipid mixture to each centrifuge tube containing receptor-1D4-resin; rotate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge lipid-receptor-1D4 resin mixture at 300 × g, 4°C for 1 minute and discard supernatant.
Add 500 μL of MSP1D1 to each tube containing the mixture; rotate at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Add approximately 20 mg of washed Bio-beads SM-2 resin to each MSP1D1-lipid-receptor-1D4 resin mixture; rotate at 4°C for 12–16 hours.
Reconstitute Bio-beads according to manufacturer instructions before use.
Wash Bio-beads with methanol and then thoroughly wash with water.
Store washed Bio-beads in water if necessary.
Centrifuge the Bio-bead-MSP1D1-lipid-receptor-1D4 resin mixture for 1 min at 300 × g, 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Wash each tube of Bio-bead-MSP1D1-lipid-receptor-1D4 resin with 500 μL HBS buffer.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 300 × g, 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Repeat steps involving washing and centrifuging twice more.
Add 500 μL of 200 μM 1D4 peptide solubilized in HBS buffer to each tube containing resin.
Rotate the mixture at 4°C for 1 hour to elute nanodisc-solubilized receptor from the 1D4 resin.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 300 × g, 4°C and collect the supernatant in a conical tube.
Repeat steps involving elution and centrifugation twice more.
Combine all collected supernatants in a single 15 mL conical tube to achieve approximately 3 mL of nanodisc-solubilized receptor.
Store the combined sample at 4°C for future use.
Concentrate nanodisc-solubilized receptor down to 500 μL using a 100 KDa membrane cutoff spin concentrator.
Centrifuge the sample for 15 min at 15,000–17,000 x g at 4°C to clear particulates before applying to the FPLC system.
Equilibrate the ATKA FPLC system with HBS buffer at 4°C.
Ensure removal of detergent from the FPLC system and SEC column using Biobeads.
Load the cleared and concentrated nanodisc-solubilized receptor sample onto the Superdex S200 column at a flow rate of 0.3–0.5 mL/min, 4°C.
Continue to pass HBS buffer through the column at a flow rate of 0.3–0.5 mL/min using 1.5 times the volume of the column bed.
Collect 0.5-mL fractions from the column and monitor absorbance at 280 nm (A280).
Analyze collected SEC fractions using SDS-PAGE.
Pool desired fractions based on A280 readings to yield the final product.
